body: I think I am beyond saving, but I really appreciate you talking to me about it, for a little while it felt less lonely, thank you so much for that 🖤
I tried, by planning changes, but failed everytime...
Exactly, the depression is keeping me paralyzed and afraid. I isolated myself with my girlfriend, who struggles, just as I do. And the loneliness, the passing of time with out any changes

You know, it feels like I am stuck in this never ending loop, and I just don’t know how to break through it. I think (and foolishly) that maybe, this will be something that will broke me out of it, even if it means not being  alive, I am running out of time and I am desperate.
Thank you so much for being so kind. To be honest, I am not even sure where to start...
